Vendored-source change to ShadowHook 2.0.1
==========================================

File: shadowhook/src/main/cpp/shadowhook.c, inside shadowhook_init.

Problem
-------
On this device (Android 16, API 36) shadowhook_init fails with
SHADOWHOOK_ERRNO_INIT_LINKER, logged by the module as
"shadowhook_init failed: Init linker mod failed". sh_linker_init looks up the
dynamic linker's internal soinfo::call_constructors, soinfo::call_destructors
and g_dl_mutex, and does not find them on this linker build.

Upstream treats that as fatal. shadowhook_check_avail returns the stored init
errno, so every later shadowhook_hook_* call is refused and no hook is ever
installed.

Why it is safe to continue
--------------------------
The linker module serves two features only:

  * symbol-name hooks on libraries that are not loaded yet
  * the DL-init and DL-fini callbacks that make those pending hooks fire

This project uses neither. It resolves libbluetooth_jni.so itself, waits for it
to appear, and then calls shadowhook_hook_func_addr with absolute addresses.
For a task created by target address, sh_task_do branches straight to
sh_switch_hook and never touches sh_linker.

Change
------
A linker-init failure now logs a warning instead of aborting init. sh_task_init
is skipped in that case, because it exists to register the DL-init/fini
callbacks that the linker module provides.

Consequence
-----------
shadowhook_hook_sym_name and pending hooks will not work in this build. Nothing
in this project calls them.
